patterns.description: List of regex patterns to match in messages. At least one pattern or one of -d/-s/-u/-E must be provided.

mailboxes.description: List of mailbox paths or directories to search. If empty, stdin is used. Supports compressed mailboxes (gzip/bzip2/lzip/xz).

output_header_only.description: Print only headers, not body. Equivalent to -H.

output_body_only.description: Print only body, not headers. Equivalent to -b.

output_minimal_headers.description: Print minimal headers (From, Date, Subject) + body. Equivalent to -B.

output_report.description: Print filenames with match counts. Equivalent to -r.

output_filenames_only.description: Print only filenames containing matches. Equivalent to -l.

output_line_numbers.description: Prefix output lines with file:line number. Equivalent to -n.

output_unique.description: Output only unique messages by Message-ID. Equivalent to -u.

output_invert.description: Invert match (print non-matching messages). Equivalent to -v.

output_mailfolder.description: Add X-Mailfolder header to output messages. Equivalent to -m.

search_word_boundary.description: Match only at word boundaries. Equivalent to -w.

search_ignore_signature.description: Ignore the signature part of messages (everything after '-- '). Equivalent to -S.

search_ignore_mime_attachments.description: Ignore non-text MIME parts. Equivalent to -M.

search_force.description: Force processing of all files as mailboxes. Equivalent to -F.

search_follow_links.description: Follow symbolic links. Implies -R. Equivalent to -L.

search_header_pattern.description: Match only in headers. Equivalent to -h.

status_flags.description: Filter by Status: header flags (e.g., 'ar' for read and answered). Order/case-insensitive. Equivalent to -j.

date_spec.description: Date specification for filtering. Supports 'today', 'yesterday', '5/18/93', 'before/after since <date>', 'between <d> and <d>'. Empty string matches messages without Date: header. Equivalent to -d.

size_spec.description: Size constraint: '=N', '<N', '<=N', '>N', '>=N', or 'A-B'. Includes header. Equivalent to -s.

expression.description: Complex search expression using Perl syntax over $email, $email_header, $email_body. Incompatible with -b, -h, -e, -i, -M, -S, -Y. Equivalent to -E.

signature_pattern.description: Regular expression to detect signature separator (default: '^-- $'). Equivalent to -X.

header_search_pattern.description: Header search pattern with procmail expansion support (^TO:, ^FROM_DAEMON:, ^FROM_MAILER:). Implies -h. Equivalent to -Y.

cache_file.description: Path to cache file (default: $HOME/.grepmail-cache). Equivalent to -C.
